waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Winthrop, drive SR-20 west about 31 miles; the Blue Lake Trailhead is on the left a little under a mile past the Washington Pass Overlook (from the west, about 42 miles from Newhalem, on the right before the overlook). The lot is small and fills early on summer weekends; a Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass is required, and SR-20 is closed over the pass in winter.

waypoints.name: Liberty Bell summit
waypoints.directions: Hike the Blue Lake Trail about 1.5 miles to the meadow just past a small stream crossing and turn left onto the climbers' path up slabs, talus and meadow into the Liberty Bell-Concord gully. A couple hundred feet below the notch, walk partway up the side gully on climber's left with a large cave and step right onto a treed ledge to start. Climb the three pitches to the top of the arete and follow the Beckey Route finish to the summit.
